_comment: Example baseline registry for the license_plate example profile: public license-plate detectors (schema: plan section 7.6 BaselineModel). Every model is single-class, so class_map sends its class 0 to the eval class named license_plate. 'weights' paths are placeholders relative to the evaluator container's working directory; download the checkpoints yourself and point these at them. The lpdnet and open-image-models backends register from this example's backends package (profile backend_modules).
